PRESIDENT'S ORDER 11 OF 1979
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 11 OF 1979
ACTING PRESIDENT (AMENDMENT)
ORDER, 1979
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 18th August 1979]
No. F.17(2)/79-Pub.-The following Order made by the
President is hereby published for general information :-
In pursuance of the Proclamation of the fifth day of
July 1977, read with the Laws (Continuance in Force) Order, 1977 (C. M. L. A.
Order No. 1 of 1977), and in exercise of all powers enabling him in that
behalf, the President is pleased to make the following Order :-
1. Short title and
commencement.-(1) This
Order may be called the Acting President (Amendment) Order, 1979.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
2. Amendment of Article 2,
P. O. No. 7 of 1978.-In
the Acting President Order, 1978 (P. O. No. 7 of 1978), hereinafter referred to
as the said Order, in Article 2, in clause (2), after the words "Chief
Justice of Pakistan", the commas and words "or, if the Chief Justice
of Pakistan is also absent from Pakistan, such other person as the President
may designate," shall be inserted.
3. Amendment of Article 3,
P. O. No. 7 of 1978.-In
the said Order, in Article 3, after the words "Chief Justice of
Pakistan", the words, commas, figures and brackets "or, as the case
may be, the person designated under clause (2) of Article 2" shall be
inserted.
